sloka: ततो रावणदाराश्च रावणश्च महाबलः ।तं देशं समनुप्राप्त यत्र सीता ऽभवत् स्थिता ।। ५.५८.६४ ।।।।
transliteration: tato rāvaṇadārāśca rāvaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।taṁ deśaṁ samanuprāpta yatra sītā 'bhavat sthitā ।। 5.58.64 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then arrived the powerful Ravana with his consorts to that place where Sita was and stood there.
